offering_description.value: Operates supermarkets and fuel centers in the southeastern United States, selling groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy goods and motor fuel to households. Also owns and leases shopping centers where its stores are located.

primary_products.value: groceries; fresh produce; meat and seafood; general merchandise; motor fuel

primary_services.value: pharmacy prescription services; shopping center leasing and management

customer_segment.value: B2C: households and individual shoppers buying food, pharmacy and fuel

end_markets.value: grocery retail; pharmacy; motor fuel retail; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: groceries, general merchandise and motor fuel sold in stores and fuel centers; healthcare reimbursement: prescriptions paid by insurers and government health programs; rental or leasing: tenants renting space in company-owned shopping centers
revenue_model.category: product sales; healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys food and goods from suppliers and sells them to households in its stores; asset operator: owns and runs supermarkets, fuel centers and shopping centers, leasing space to tenants

geography_served.value: US regional: North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee and Virginia

specialization.value: related lines: supermarkets, pharmacies, fuel centers and shopping center real estate

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated supermarkets and fuel centers; online: online orders for store pickup and home delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pharmacy licensing by state boards, food safety and alcohol and fuel rules from state and federal agencies
